title: The Riemannian geometry of the configuration space of gauge theories
scope_note: Develops the metric, connection, curvature and geodesics of the gauge-orbit configuration space from the kinetic energy; relates Gribov ambiguity to conjugate points. Supplies geometric definitions for G20/G23. Its publisher abstract does not establish a quantum mass gap, a weighted Bakry-Emery bound, or a continuum construction.
